identificationModule.briefTitle: BIBW 2992 (Afatinib) vs Gemcitabine-cisplatin in 1st Line Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: LUX-Lung 6: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase III Study of BIBW 2992 Versus Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for Patients With Stage IIIB or IV Adenocarcinoma of the Lung Harbouring an EGFR Activating Mutation

armGroups.label: Arm A BIBW 2992
armGroups.description: Patients receive a tablet of BIBW 2992 daily until progression or unacceptable toxicity

armGroups.label: Arm B Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Patients receive Gemcitabine and Cisplatin, maximum is 6 courses

interventions.name: Gemcitabine+Cisplatin
interventions.description: Gemcitabine d1,8, Cisplatin d1, 21 days as a course, up to 6 courses.

interventions.name: BIBW 2992
interventions.description: starting dose is 40 mg, in the event of no or minimal drug-related adverse events after one course, the dose will be increased to 50mg. in the event of certain drug related Adverse Event (AE), dose reduction will be increments of 10 mg, with the lowest dose being 20mg.
